rows.label: SOCIETY
rows.clue: An extended social group having a distinctive cultural and economic organization

rows.label: QUORUM
rows.clue: A gathering of the minimal number of members of an organization to conduct business

rows.label: FEAST
rows.clue: A ceremonial dinner party for many people

rows.label: CHAIN
rows.clue: A series of things depending on each other as if linked together

rows.label: TOP BRASS
rows.clue: The most important persons in a governing body

rows.label: SEMINARY
rows.clue: A private place of education for the young

rows.label: CLASS
rows.clue: A collection of things sharing a common attribute

rows.label: BIG BAND
rows.clue: A large dance or jazz band usually featuring improvised solos by lead musicians

rows.label: CARAVAN
rows.clue: A procession (of wagons or mules or camels) traveling together in single file

rows.label: BIT FIELD
rows.clue: A field containing only binary characters

rows.label: GROVE
rows.clue: A small growth of trees without underbrush
